artworks.title: Francois-Theodore de Nesmond
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a bust-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man's head and upper torso are visible, with his body slightly turned towards his right, yet his face looks at the viewer. He has a gentle expression, with defined facial features including a mustache and small goatee. His hair is wavy and shoulder-length, and he wears a small cap. He is dressed in a lined garment over a richly textured, fur-collared cloak. Around his neck, there appears to be a bow-tied lace. Beneath the frame, a coat of arms with intricate design and lion figures flanking it is visible. The background of the image features a pattern of vertical lines.

artworks.title: Marie d'Orléans-Longueville, Duchesse de Nemours
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body with delicate facial features, voluminous curly hair, and a low-cut dress with bows. She wears a string of pearls around her neck. The background has a dark texture, and the portrait is framed with fleur-de-lis motifs. French text is displayed below the image.

artworks.title: Henri II, Duc de Nemours
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person with wavy, shoulder-length hair and refined facial features. The person is wearing a formal garment with a high, white collar and a large, intricately patterned fabric covering the shoulders. A large cross pendant hangs around the neck. The background is detailed, and the portrait is framed within an oval. Below the oval, there is a decorative coat of arms.

artworks.title: Henri II, Duc de Nemours
artworks.description: The image portrays an individual in an oval frame. The person is facing slightly right but looks directly at the viewer. They have well-defined facial features, shoulder-length wavy hair, and wear a formal robe with intricate patterns. The person has a prominent nose and lips, and their eyes engage the viewer. They wear a cross necklace. The background features a textured pattern within an oval frame with a layered border design. Below the image is a coat of arms or emblem.

artworks.title: Henri, Marquis de Mouy
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person in ornate armor with long hair, a mustache, and a white lace collar. They are posed with the body angled to the left and the face turned towards the viewer. The portrait is oval-shaped with an elaborate patterned border and a crest featuring a coat of arms and a crown below it. The background has fine lines radiating outward, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Jean de Montpezat de Carbon
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving depicting the upper half of a man's body facing directly towards the viewer. He has long, wavy hair reaching just above the shoulders, parted in the middle, along with facial features such as defined brows and a subtle smile. The man wears a dark robe with a wide, white collar and a cross pendant on a chain around his neck. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, and there is an emblem or coat of arms below the image. The background is textured with parallel lines.

artworks.title: Francois Mole
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a bust of a man in a slight three-quarter turn towards his right. The man has prominent features, including a nose, lips, and downturned eyes. He has curly, shoulder-length hair framing his face. The clothing is detailed, with a high-collared shirt and a draped, ornate garment resembling a robe. There is a decorative chain around his neck. The image is within an intricately designed oval frame with a coat of arms at the bottom. The background consists of tightly spaced lines for texture. The engraving is monochrome and bordered by a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Mathieu Mole
artworks.description: This print is a portrait of a man with light skin, a long, square white beard, a white mustache, wavy white hair, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. The man is smiling slightly. He wears a black cap and a black jacket with a large white collar and several buttons down the front. The background behind him is dark gray. Surrounding him is an oval frame with a coat of arms at the bottom, featuring elaborate designs including several lions. The background outside of the oval is made from gray horizontal and vertical lines against off-white paper.

artworks.title: Edouard Mole
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust of a man in a portrait style, showing his upper body and head. He is facing the viewer with a calm demeanor, featuring a prominent beard and mustache, neatly combed back hair, and wearing a textured garment with a large ruff collar. The background includes an ornate oval-shaped frame with decorative patterns and text along the edges. There is additional engraved text below the portrait, likely identifying the subject.

artworks.title: Jean-Antoine de Mesmes
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the upper body of a man who is positioned facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a long, narrow face with pronounced cheekbones, a small pointed beard, and thin lips. His hair is curly and falls to just above his shoulders, and he wears a small cap on the crown of his head. The man's clothing consists of a fur-trimmed cloak over what appears to be formal attire, including a visible collar. No jewelry or handheld objects are present. The background features an oval frame with dense, linear patterns surrounding the figure, and below the portrait is a decorative coat of arms with ornate designs, including a crescent moon and a star, flanked by roses or lions.

artworks.title: Henri de Mesmes
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, with his body turned slightly to the right while his face looks directly at the viewer. The man has shoulder-length, wavy hair and a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His facial features include a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. He is wearing a garment with a high fur collar and a patterned shawl or wrap draped over his shoulder. The background is a detailed pattern of lines and fleur-de-lis designs, framing the oval in which the portrait is enclosed.

artworks.title: Jean de Mesgrigny
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper body visible. He is facing the right, with his left hand resting on a round object. He has a long, thin nose, a mustache, prominent cheekbones, and shoulder-length, wavy hair parted in the middle. He is wearing a draped garment covering his shoulders and chest. He is not wearing any visible jewelry. The background features an oval frame with a crest at the base, including a lion symbol and ornamental motifs. The text around the oval indicates the man's title as “J.C. Mesgrin President au Mortier au Parlement de Provence.”

artworks.title: Louis de Bourbon-Vendome, Duc de Mercoeur
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic portrait of a man positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. He is holding an object resembling a baton or staff, with a strong posture and his left hand extended. The man has a focused gaze, a prominent nose, slight smile, medium-length, curly hair, and is dressed in ornate armor with a cape draped over his left shoulder. The background features a textured oval frame with decorative elements such as coronets and ribbons.

artworks.title: Gilles Menage
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing slightly left, with a neutral expression. The man has mid-length wavy hair and is wearing a dark-colored garment with a high collar and button detailing on the sleeves. In his right hand, he holds an open book, with another book on the table in front of him. The background has a simple textured pattern.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, positioned in a three-quarter view facing the viewer's left. The man's facial features are well-defined, with a prominent nose, a mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. His hair is long, curly, and light in color, falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a broad collar over a robe. Surrounding him is an elaborate oval frame with inscriptions, and elaborate drapery featuring decorative elements such as wreaths and star motifs. Behind the frame, the background is filled with classical architectural elements such as columns and ornate drapery.

artworks.title: Pierre Dupuy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man has a long, oval-shaped face with a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and short, graying hair. He wears a cap and a dark coat with a high collar and buttons. The portrait is framed within an oval border, with an ornate coat of arms below it, featuring two lions flanking a shield. The background has parallel lines for texture, typical of an engraved portrait. Below the coat of arms is text, likely identifying the individual.

artworks.title: Charles d'Orléans-Longueville, Comte de Dunois
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, facing forward with a slight turn of the head to the left. They have delicate features, full lips, and long, wavy hair cascading around their shoulders. The person wears a historical outfit with a high collar and a luxurious buttoned garment. There is an oval frame with inscriptions, ornate detailing, and a coat of arms in the background, emphasizing the subject's portrait within the bordered frame.

artworks.title: Antoine Dulieu
artworks.description: This image displays a bust-length portrait of a person looking directly at the viewer. The individual has a fair complexion, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips. Their hair is voluminous and curly, flowing down to their shoulders and light in color. They wear a formal garment with a white rectangular collar, suggesting historical attire, featuring elaborate folds and textures. The person is surrounded by an oval frame with Latin text on the border. Below the frame, there is ornate decoration including a coat of arms. The background consists of fine, detailed lines.

artworks.title: Jean Dorieu
artworks.description: The image shows a man in 17th-century attire with long, wavy hair, wearing a dark coat with a white collar. He has prominent cheekbones and an aquiline nose, appearing thoughtful. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscriptions and a decorative emblem or crest with a shield and stars.

artworks.title: Marcechal de Cequi
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in an upper body portrait. He is positioned slightly angled to the right and looking toward the left. The man has a long nose, a serene expression with arched eyebrows and a slight smile. He has curly shoulder-length hair. The man is wearing a detailed breastplate, a lace collar, and a draped sash across his chest. He is not wearing jewelry or holding any objects. The background features an oval border with radiating lines, creating depth. The border below includes a heraldic emblem and script, and there is a printed biography in the rectangular area under the circular frame.

artworks.title: Honore Courtin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, positioned to face slightly to the right while gazing forward, directly at the viewer. He has a round face with a slight smile and large, expressive eyes. The man has voluminous, curly hair that falls to his shoulders, framing his face. He is dressed in a formal outfit with a high lace or frilled cravat at the neck, and a dark coat. The image is set within an ornate oval frame with striped detailing, and a detailed coat of arms positioned below the oval. The background is a finely striped pattern, contrasting with the solid black within the frame.

artworks.title: Louis II, Prince de Conde
artworks.description: The image is an illustrated portrait of a man from the chest up, posed in a formal stance with his body slightly turned to the right and facing the viewer. His facial features include a prominent nose and a stoic expression. He has long, curly hair that cascades over his shoulders. The man wears elaborate attire typical of historical nobility, including a robe with detailed patterns and a large lace collar. There is a star-shaped medallion on his chest. The portrait is enclosed within an ornately designed oval frame featuring a wreath motif, and beneath the frame is a decorative shield adorned with fleur-de-lis symbols and a crown. The background comprises a textured pattern.
